verdict.rationale: Manufact documents multiple programmatic surfaces — API keys for a REST API used in CI/scripts (manufact-docs-17), a CLI for managing servers/deployments from the terminal (manufact-docs-15,16,26), and an official MCP server exposing platform/org/server/deployment/logs/observability as MCP tools so agents like Cursor/Claude can manage everything (manufact-docs-14,31, manufact-probe-3). However, a direct probe for a discoverable REST API spec (OpenAPI/Swagger) returned 404 on all candidate paths, indicating the REST API itself lacks public reference documentation (manufact-probe-2). Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST API reference or endpoint catalog, and independent confirmation that the REST API is usable end-to-end beyond API-key issuance.
